signal: Customer confirmation: Micron EVP Bhatia says TSMC will make Micron's HBM4E logic base dies, both standard and custom, ramping in 2027 [G, via TrendForce 2026-05]. TSMC itself disclosed the C-HBM4E custom base die on N3P with the controller integrated [R, TrendForce 2025-12-01].
Q2-26 DRAM revenue ~$85M, about two-thirds HBM, plus two HBM4 SmartMatrix adoptions [R, 8-K 2026-07-29]. All of this is core/stack test, which is out of scope.

Magnum 7H product scope includes HBM4/4E base-die wafer test [R, BusinessWire 2025-08-04]. Q2-26 memory test revenue was a record $212M, and management reportedly cited growth in base-die test [secondary MarketBeat summary; transcript unverified].
Custom HBM compute architecture announced with Micron, Samsung and SK hynix [R, Marvell PR 2024-12-10, stale].
TSMC's 1Q26 call reportedly lists HBM base dies among N3 customers and capacity adds [analyst summary, Silicon Analysts 2026-04-16].
SPTS plus PCB/Component Inspection guided to grow more than 25% in CY2026 on HPC packaging [G, Nasdaq/Zacks].
An unnamed leading foundry selected Nova WMC for multiple advanced-packaging layers; WMC is deployed at memory and foundry customers, including for HBM [R, Nova PR 2026-07-02].
Advanced-packaging revenue expected to grow more than 50% in CY2026 [G, Zacks; source URL malformed, unverified].
Advanced packaging guided to grow more than 40% in 2026, citing TSV etch and electroplating leadership for HBM4/4E [G, MarketBeat 2026-01-28].
Volume purchase agreement of more than $240M with an HBM maker for Dragonfly bump metrology through 2027 [R, 8-K 2026-02].
More than $260M of orders and forecasts from two HBM makers for 3D metrology and 2D inspection over 2026-27 [R/G, Q1-26 call].
Micron EVP: TSMC will make the HBM4E logic base dies; FQ4-26 call: the HBM4E base die for NVHBM and JEDEC parts uses a foundry process [G, TrendForce / secondary FourWeekMBA].
NVHBM moves the memory controller into the HBM base die [secondary, FourWeekMBA 2026-08]; the GTC 2026 roadmap shows Feynman with custom HBM [R].

The Q4 FY26 8-K cites 'increasing demand for ultra-high-power CPO lasers, an initial order for ELS modules' and says Lumentum is on track for meaningful CPO revenue exiting CY2026 [R, SEC 2026-08-11]. Calls also describe booked UHP POs: the largest commitment in company history, plus a multi-hundred-million-dollar scale-out PO delivering 1H CY2027 [G].
The Sherman, TX 6-inch InP fab is ramping UHP CW lasers for CPO, and CPO starts contributing revenue in FQ2 FY27 (the Dec-2026 quarter) [G, Coherent Q4 FY26 press release / Futurum 2026-08].
Launch of a 400 mW narrow-linewidth 1310 nm DFB for SiPh/CPO [R, 2025-12-18], plus 55-65% ELS gross-margin guidance as production ramps in 2027 [G, Q2-26 call].

An ELS-engine development agreement with an unnamed 'Tier 1 laser company' [Q2-26 release, 2026-08-13] and an unnamed 'significant NRE agreement for ELS' [G, AGM 2026-06-30]. Neither gives a counterparty, value or date.

USI's subsidiary released a UHP ELSFP series: samples 4Q25-2Q26, trial production 3Q-4Q26, mass production 1Q27 [G, secondhand Chinese press]. USI's acquisition of a controlling stake in EugenLight is completed [R, 2026-01].
Nvidia was 16.3% of FY26 revenue [R, 10-K].

Lumentum InP capacity reservation through 2031 ($43.5M deposits) and Coherent 6-inch InP supply agreement [R, 8-Ks 2026-07]; neither names an application. Q2-26 InP revenue was a record $30.7M, 'primarily data center' [R].
More than $250M of Spector IBD, Lumina MOCVD and WaferEtch orders from multiple unnamed customers for InP laser manufacturing [R/G, 2026-05-26].
Corning positions its PM fiber and FAUs between external lasers and PICs and targets a ~$10B photonics platform by 2030 [G].
Spectrum-X/Quantum-X Photonics uses 16-18 ELS per switch [R, NVIDIA blog 2025, stale].
Davisson CPO ships with field-replaceable ELSFP modules; the laser vendor is not named [R, The Next Platform 2025-10-17].
Celestial AI's 2023 advance PO for POET Starlight, cancelled by Marvell (notice 2026-04-23).
FUJI, Broadcom and Celestica joint CPO assembly evaluation [3P, EE Times Japan 2026-10-09].

Scorpio X, a dedicated PCIe-6 scale-up switch, is in volume production at initial customers and drives the Q3-26 guide of $540-560M (+40% QoQ) [G/R, 8-K Ex.99.1 / Futurum 2026-08-04]. Amazon holds a warrant that vests on up to $6.5B of purchases, including smart-fabric switches [R, 8-K 2026-02].

Named design win: the AMD Helios scale-up fabric uses 12 Broadcom TH6 per 72-GPU rack [R, ServeTheHome 2026-10]. Partner confirmation: Celestica's DS6010 dual-TH6 tray is 'fully qualified' for Helios [R]. Tomahawk Ultra scale-up deployment began in FQ3 FY26 [G].
Weak: ~$540M XConn acquisition for scale-up switching with ~$100M FY28 revenue guided (all uses) [G]; UALink 115T samples 2H FY27, volume FY28 [G]. No named socket.
Four 10%+ customers at ~33%, 28%, 13% and 10% of Q1 FY27 revenue of $479.0M [R].

Named win: AMD's press release (2026-03-16) says Celestica undertakes R&D, design and manufacturing of the Helios scale-up (UALoE) networking switches [R]. The DS6010 dual-TH6 tray is 'fully qualified' for Helios [R].
Launch of the ESUN-based Etherlink SU-144 rack-scale scale-up system, with engineering partners AMD, Arm, Broadcom, d-Matrix, Meta, Microsoft and Qualcomm [R, Arista PR 2026-10-07].

HPE will offer AMD Helios racks in 2026 [R, The Register 2025-12-02], with its own Juniper QFX5252 204.8T scale-up switch for Helios [secondary blog of the HPE Discover showcase, 2026-06-19]. The AVGO deep dive cites HPE/BusinessWire 2025-12-02 for a UALoE tray 'built with Broadcom' (not re-read).
Astera's 10-K: Astera is fabless and TSMC manufactures all of its ICs [R, 2026-02].
Astera's 10-K names ASE (and Amkor) as its assembly, packaging and test suppliers [R, 2026-02].
Astera's 10-K names Amkor as an assembly, packaging and test supplier [R, 2026-02].
The UALink and Ultra Ethernet IP launch named AMD, Astera, Juniper, Tenstorrent and XConn as collaborators [R, Dec-2024, stale].
AMD's press release (2026-03-16) says Celestica designs and builds the Helios UALoE scale-up switches [R].
Trainium3 uses a 144-chip domain through NeuronSwitch-v1, supplier unnamed [R, AWS Neuron docs]. Amazon holds the Astera warrant tied to up to $6.5B of purchases [R].
